_comment: Identities for the golden QA run (evals/run_qa.py). 'steward' holds 'brain-admins' — the unrestricted group — and answers the answerable questions. 'analyst' holds 'product' and NOT 'sales', which is what makes the acl-probe family a real measurement in BOTH directions: it reads the product-labelled page (the audience check works) and is refused the sales-labelled ones with no existence leak (the audience check excludes). A principal holding nothing would only ever prove the second. Open is the ABSENCE of a label, so no page carries 'all' — that is a group name nobody may hold.
